tests.name: TicketStore migrates a persisted ownerless database without changing legacy ticket data
TicketStore persists every ownership transition without changing unrelated fields or regressing timestamps
TicketStore performs no database write for repeated assigned and unassigned ownership
TicketStore combines exact owner result sets with existing queue filters
TicketStore rejects invalid ownership requests without mutating any ticket
TicketStore keeps creation unassigned and preserves ownership during status updates
ownership action rejects forged owners and missing tickets without mutating any row
ownership action assigns, reassigns, and clears ownership while revalidating queue and detail
Dashboard renders synchronized accessible owner filtering and unfiltered summary cards
Ticket detail and creation renders assigned and unassigned owner metadata with an accessible handoff while keeping intake ownerless
